title: Demonic Sorceress of War
description: A female demonic sorceress with horns, long dark hair, and multiple white fox tails stands dynamically amid a battlefield of fallen armored warriors and broken swords. She holds a glowing pink heart symbol in one hand and a swirling blue energy orb in the other, surrounded by red lightning, dark smoke, and floating debris.
prompt: A powerful female demonic sorceress with black horns, long flowing dark hair, and multiple large white fox tails stained with blood stands in a dramatic pose on a battlefield covered in fallen armored knights and broken swords.
